about: indie pop/rock: a roomy acoustic kit played simply (kick 1 and 3, snare 2 and 4, straight 8th hats), a picked bass on steady root 8ths, jangly strummed clean guitar chords, a glockenspiel hook on top; 100-140 BPM, a little raw, mid-forward
master: natural and a little raw: mid-forward guitars, roomy drums, light compression; not hyper-polished, no heavy low-pass
